name: Twilio Developer Kit
description: Twilio Skills provide procedural knowledge for AI coding agents — which APIs to use, in what order, and what to avoid. Covers SMS, Voice, WhatsApp, Verify, SendGrid, Compliance, and 30+ products.
longDescription:
Ships **57 skills** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (57): `twilio-account-setup` (Create and configure a Twilio account from scratch), `twilio-agent-augmentation-architect` (Planning skill for augmenting human agents with real-time AI intelligence), `twilio-agent-connect`, `twilio-ai-agent-architect` (Planning skill for AI-powered conversational agents), `twilio-call-recordings` (Record Twilio voice calls correctly), `twilio-cli-reference` (Twilio CLI reference for managing Twilio resources from the terminal), `twilio-compliance-onboarding` (Registrations required BEFORE Twilio traffic works), `twilio-compliance-traffic` (Rules you must follow for Twilio messaging and voice traffic), and 49 more
- **MCP servers** (1): `twilio-docs`

Installs with `claude plugin install twilio-developer-kit@claude-plugins-official` from `twilio/ai`.
